question: On the same exact selected-chart prime-field decomposition predicate, does a CDCL, CNF-XOR or QF_FF solver bundle show lower complete-work growth than exact enumeration and F4 on unseen natural targets, with exact correctness, A/A, planted and matched-null controls?

claims.text: Every completed backend row agrees with the canonical evaluator and independent group-law replay; enumerable cells have identical projected model sets.

At least one preregistered SAT solver/representation bundle has lower complete retired-instruction growth than exact candidate enumeration and is below F4 on the two largest jointly completed rungs, outside A/A spread.
claims.if_supported: the frozen SAT bundle advances to a complete relation-collection experiment; no asymptotic or ECDLP speedup claim
claims.if_not_supported: the frozen SAT bundle is not advanced under the stated ladder and limits; no universal SAT impossibility claim

claims.text: The CDCL bundle uses elliptic/decomposition structure beyond a support- and model-count-matched curve-free null on the tested cells.
claims.if_supported: a scoped structure effect on these predicates
claims.if_not_supported: within the matched-null distribution on these metrics; not proof that the predicate is random

claims.text: A finite solver panel proves or disproves subexponential prime-field ECDLP complexity.
claims.if_not_supported: only a proof/counterexample to the relevant theorem can decide the asymptotic statement

hypotheses.statement: A compact shared-coefficient predicate exposes enough local Boolean structure that at least one SAT bundle prunes a growing fraction of the exact candidate space.
hypotheses.mechanism: Quotient/remainder layers share coefficients across all roots and avoid the free quotient-carry pattern of the earlier direct Semaev bit-blast.

predictions.minimum_effect: upper corrected 95% interval at most 0.85 across the three largest rungs

data_seen.measured: known-witness correctness only; no unknown solve or retired-instruction data for the declared cells
a different direct Semaev QF_BV representation

provenance.decisive_scope: the four frozen shared-coefficient rungs and solver versions only

hypotheses.statement: Any CDCL reduction is caused by the elliptic/shared-coefficient structure rather than sparse-system shape alone.
hypotheses.mechanism: The curve equations and shared remainder identities create repeated implications absent from a coefficient-randomized support-matched null.

predictions.minimum_effect: paired candidate/null median ratio at most 0.8 on the three largest rungs with corrected 95% interval below 1

instance_sampling.rule: For each of four rungs generate eight natural, eight planted and eight exact-UNSAT instances from protocol-hash seeds before assigning arms; generate one paired matched null per instance.

power.note: Draft freeze blocker: preflight must justify power for a 15% slope reduction and 1.5x paired instruction ratio under observed log-ratio variance. Passing p-value resolution alone would not establish this power.

primary.name: verified model status
primary.unit: status and canonical projected model set
primary.definition: From backend result through canonical IR evaluation, root extraction and independent group replay; enumerable cells compare the complete projected model set.

primary.name: complete retired instructions
primary.definition: First target-dependent IR compilation instruction through backend exit, model/proof extraction and independent verification; includes serialization and parsing, excludes separately reported reusable target-independent setup.

primary.name: peak resident memory
primary.definition: Maximum resident set of the wrapper and all solver descendants over the complete target-dependent interval.

primary.name: normalized complete-work growth slope
primary.unit: delta log2(instructions) / delta log2(exact candidate-space size)
primary.definition: Robust slope over completed rungs, paired by instance class; no imputation for timeouts.
primary.source: analysis output from retired_instructions and instance.exact_candidate_space
primary.formula: Theil-Sen slope of log2(retired_instructions) on log2(exact_candidate_space)

secondary.name: SAT native-work sensitivity band
secondary.definition: Decisions plus conflicts plus w times propagations, separately for w=0,0.1,1; reported as a band and never converted to group additions.

secondary.name: F4 solving degree
secondary.definition: Largest productive degree reported by the pinned F4 backend for the canonical polynomial system.

secondary.name: complete cold wall time
secondary.definition: The same complete target-dependent interval as retired_instructions on an L2 row; invalid after restore or below L2.

placement.memory: set from preflight with identical per-arm limit

stopping_rules.rule: Fixed design: 8 arms x 96 instances x (1 warmup + 3 measured fresh-process replicates), subject only to the same preregistered per-row timeout and memory limit; then stop.
Run the planted positive-control block first; a miss invalidates affected negative readings but all attempted rows remain in the export.
Timeouts, OOMs and nonzero solver exits are outcomes and are not retried; only recorded infrastructure failures may retry once.

invalidation_rules: a SAT witness that fails canonical evaluation or independent group replay is wrong_answer and invalidates that arm/cell
an UNSAT result without a checked proof object is unknown, not unsat
a natural/null pair without the preregistered shape and model-class/count match is excluded from C-structure and reported
a row without valid retired-instruction counters is excluded from instruction comparisons and reported
wall time below L2 or after restore is descriptive only with wall_valid false
a failed planted control makes the corresponding negative reading inconclusive

decision_rule.text: C2 is supported within scope only when one preregistered SAT bundle verifies every completed row, completes all four natural rungs, has Holm-corrected upper 95% growth-slope interval <=0.85 across the three largest rungs, and has complete retired-instruction ratio below 1 versus F4 on the two largest jointly completed rungs outside A/A spread. It is not advanced only when the lower slope interval is >=0.95 on three consecutive rungs or every SAT bundle is censored before F4 on both largest jointly attempted rungs. Other censoring is inconclusive. C3 is separate and requires candidate/null ratio <=0.8 on the three largest rungs with corrected interval below 1.
decision_rule.threshold: slope <=0.85 and SAT/F4 instructions <1 for advance; slope >=0.95 or uniform earlier censoring for not-advanced; structure ratio <=0.8 for C3
decision_rule.statistic: paired median instruction ratios and Theil-Sen log-work slope, bootstrapped over held-out instances
decision_rule.interval: paired bootstrap 95% intervals, Holm-adjusted over three candidate bundles
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: instruction ratio, slope difference, and candidate/null instruction ratio, each shown against A/A spread

graphs: complete retired instructions versus exact candidate-space size by opaque arm
paired SAT/F4 instruction ratios with A/A interval

inadmissible: taking affected pilot or benchmark data before the protocol is frozen and committed
changing cells, seeds, primes, curves, target class, null generator, budgets or thresholds after seeing output
comparing different selected/repeated-root charts across solver arms
omitting rationality, extraction, proof, setup or verification work from one arm
treating timeout, unknown or unproved UNSAT as no solution
selecting favorable solver seeds, variable orders or propagation weights
imputing censored work to manufacture a slope
reading a solver-stage result as a complete ECDLP or rho comparison
reading a finite slope as proof of subexponential complexity
